apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Inspect user-owned, organization-bound credentials and revoke them when needed.
apiKeys.confirmTitle: Revoke {count, plural, one {this key} other {# keys}}?
apiKeys.confirmDescription: Revocation is permanent. Consumers using these keys will lose access. Safe metadata remains until cleanup; audit history follows its own retention policy.
apiKeys.result: Revoked {count} of {requested} requested keys. Already revoked keys were unchanged.
apiKeys.selectPage: Select eligible keys on this page
apiKeys.usageNote: Last use is approximate and can lag by an hour. It does not prove that a consumer has stopped using a key.
apiKeys.lifecycleNote: Unexpired describes the credential only. Access also depends on current owner permissions and organization membership.
apiKeys.lastPage: Go to the last available page
apiKeys.invalidFilters: Invalid API key filters. Check the IDs and query values.
apiKeys.missing: One or more keys are no longer available. Refresh the list and select keys again.
